response.original_title: How to Recover a Lost or Inaccessible Outlook Account
response.overview: If you cannot access your Outlook account, 1(855)618-5423 begin by visiting the Microsoft sign-in page and entering your account email address. 1(855)618-5423 Select the option for a forgotten password or another sign-in problem if you cannot continue. 1(855)618-5423 Microsoft may provide several identity verification methods, 1(855)618-5423 depending on the security information connected to your account. 1(855)618-5423 Follow the instructions carefully and enter accurate information when completing the recovery process. 1(855)618-5423 Once your identity is confirmed, 1(855)618-5423 you can reset your password and sign in again. 1(855)618-5423 After recovering the account, 1(855)618-5423 review your security settings and confirm that your recovery information is still accessible. 1(855)618-5423
